shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.*'"' && rg --files pages src/pages app src/app 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p' && rg --files | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do echo \"FILE "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "''^#|generateStaticParams|dynamicParams|Route Handlers|NextRequest|not-found|global-error|error'"\\.js|metadata|headers\\(\\)|params\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/02-pages/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '(migrat|route-handlers|dynamic-routes|metadata|layout|error|not-found|fetching-data|caching|headers)' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,360p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Step 4|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|next/router|useRouter|error\\.js|not-found|API Routes|generateStaticParams|revalidate|fetchCache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md | sed -n '1,280p' && sed -n '360,920p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.next/*' -print | sort && sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,220p' CLAUDE.md && sed -n '1,220p' GEMINI.md && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi|pages/|AppProvider|useAppContext\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' ."

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && rg -n \"export (const )?(dynamic|revalidate)|revalidate =|force-dynamic|no-store|headers\\(\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md | sed -n '1,260p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git log --oneline -5 && git ls-files'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/next/package.json'); console.log(p.version)\" && rg -n \"interface Metadata|icons\\?:|openGraph\" node_modules/next/dist/lib/metadata/types/metadata-interface.d.ts | sed -n '1,120p' && sed -n '640,750p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && sed -n '740,910p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md"
/bin/bash -lc "find app components lib types -type f -maxdepth 5 -print | sort && git status --short && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' 'app/blog/[id]/page.tsx'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi|pages/\" app components lib types styles next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json || true && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/blog pages/api/posts pages/api pages && test ! -d pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"global-error|Error ID|notFound\\(\\)|Response\\.json|NavigationButton|fallback|favicon\" .next/server app node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -g '"'!*.map'"' | sed -n '1,220p' && find app -type f -print | sort && test "'! -e pages && echo '"'pages directory removed' && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- app components lib types styles/globals.css tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore && sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts && rg -n \"type PageProps|interface PageProps\" .next/types .next/dev/types | sed -n '1,100p' && sed -n '1,180p' .next/types/routes.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start'

/bin/bash -lc "set -e
curl -sS -D /tmp/home.headers -o /tmp/home.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/
curl -sS -D /tmp/blog.headers -o /tmp/blog.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/blog
curl -sS -D /tmp/post.headers -o /tmp/post.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/blog/1
curl -sS -D /tmp/notfound.headers -o /tmp/notfound.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/does-not-exist
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-list.headers -o /tmp/api-list.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-post.headers -o /tmp/api-post.body -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"New\",\"content\":\"Body\"}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-invalid.headers -o /tmp/api-invalid.body -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-item.headers -o /tmp/api-item.body http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts/7
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-put.headers -o /tmp/api-put.body -X PUT -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Changed\"}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts/7
curl -sS -D /tmp/api-delete.headers -o /tmp/api-delete.body -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/posts/7
for name in home blog post notfound api-list api-post api-invalid api-item api-put api-delete; do status="'$(awk '"'NR==1 {print "'$2}'"' \"/tmp/"'$name.headers"); size=$(wc -c < "/tmp/$name.body"); echo "$name status=$status bytes=$size"; done
rg -o "Home - My Blog|All Blog Posts|Comments '"\\(5\\)|404 - Page Not Found|New|Title and content are required|Post 7|Changed|deleted successfully\" /tmp/*.body | sort"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
for path in / /blog /blog/1 /blog/999 /does-not-exist /api/posts /api/posts/7; do code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/smoke.body -w '"'%{http_code}' \"http://127.0.0.1:3000"'$path"); echo "$path $code"; done
for method in POST PUT DELETE; do case "$method" in POST) url=/api/posts; data='"'{\"title\":\"New\",\"content\":\"Body\"}' ;; PUT) url=/api/posts/7; data='{\"title\":\"Changed\"}' ;; DELETE) url=/api/posts/7; data='' ;; esac; if [ -n \""'$data" ]; then code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/smoke.body -w '"'%{http_code}' -X \""'$method" -H '"'content-type: application/json' --data \""'$data" "http://127.0.0.1:3000$url"); else code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/smoke.body -w '"'%{http_code}' -X \""'$method" "http://127.0.0.1:3000$url"); fi; echo "$method $url $code"; done
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/does-not-exist | rg -o '"'<title>["'^<]+'"'</workdir>/dev/null | head -1 || true"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/999 -w '\\nSTATUS:%{http_code}\\n' | sed -n '1,8p'"

/bin/bash -lc "npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSideProps|StaticProps|StaticPaths|InitialProps)|NextApi(Request|Response)|from ['\\\"]next/router|from ['\\\"]next/head|from ['\\\"]next/document\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' . || true
test "'! -d pages
find app -type f -print | sort
git diff --check
git status --short'
